newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar adding to forest products arena.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar adding to forest products arena.

text.p: Caterpillar Inc said Monday it agreed to acquire the majority stake of privately held Skogsjan AB, a Swedish-based company that manufactures "cut-to-length" forestry machines and equipment, including forwarders, wheeled harvesters and harvester heads.
Skogsjan's products complement Caterpillar's existing line of forest equipment which includes wheeled and track-type skidders, log loaders, delimbers and custom-built products.
Skosgjan distributes its wares in Sweden, Norway, Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.
Caterpillar manufactures construction and mining equipment and natural gas engines. It also produces diesel engines.
